search_text: published ZDI-24-1636 ZDI-CAN-24812 Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support DESTA Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-12-02 CVE-2024-53673 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-53673 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Hewlett Packard Enterprise'] ['Insight Remote Support'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support. title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support DESTA Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hewlett Packard Enterprise Insight Remote Support. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the DESTA service, which listens on TCP port 7901 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
